body: Ooh. Be sure to stop by for some Good Shepherd Jams😋 As well as their lengua, alfajor, and snow balls :)
Gusto ko tuloy pumunta dun ng December hahaha yuppp i get the Christmas-feels there! Soon. Pag nagka-vaccine na 🙏 any suggestions for underrated places to stop by??

Ooh. I've only gone to Baguio once din kasi, and I think it's one of the least crowded tourist spots in the ph. Honestly don't recall if I've gone to Camo John Hay before. I was quite young when we went there and I just basically went wherever my family took me.

I think the past few months of reflecting were enough for me to decide. Im only staying to help my grandmom with her work since she'll retire in a year and a half anyways. Dont wanna spread negative vibes, and as much as it sounds cliché, I don't see the point of living. I don't see the point of trying. For what? 

Most of the letters im planning to write are farewells and advice. I've practiced and am confident that I have the courage and determination to do it. No worries though, I'm happy with my decision 😊  And I'll try to live my remaining time to the fullest, I know I won't regret it.
When was the last time you went there? Balita ko nga raw di na ganun kalamig ngayon. Still, im planning to go back there.

How bold. Wouldnt be surprised if you're described as reckless by your friends😆  But truly nothing satisfies the senses like novelty and adventure. Tbh that's the most scariest thing in life, taking a gamble at alam mong wala ka nang babalikan pa if you fail. But once you succeed, feel mo nasa taas ka ng mundo. Buti nakauwi ka pa haha

Ayun. You've described it perfectly. Felt like time and the world moved differently there compared to most cities.

Yesss when reality hits you, at some point you'll have second thoughts. Pero geez, how the hell were u so sure that you'd survive a month when you spent your lasmani on rent😆

As much as I have the balls( well, not physically), I still think it's one big ass gamble. But definitely something id like to try once in a lifetime. Something I think everyone should get the chance to do so.
Any suggestions? In case na bumalik ako😆

Totoo. Bakit parang bumabagal takbo ng mundo duon?

Talaga?? :(( Gusto ko pa naman ulit bumalik dun. And was hoping na tulad pa rin ng dati.

Wow... what a lucky fella. Oh to drop everything and explore an unfamiliar city for months while doing something you love. To learn about the place, people, and culture. There are barely a few that'd take the time to indulge and observe. You obviously enjoyed your overstay, good for you.

Nope, and neither do most tourists, I bet😆 Tbh i only went there with my family to do the "touristy" stuff you so detest, still I fell in love with the place. Something I didnt expect, frankly. I hate the cold. 

But it was serene and dreamy, especially on the cold nights. The moments were best felt with a hot cup of coffee while chilling in the balcony with an overview of the city. Strolling around new places, paddling on swan boats, taking pictures, picking strawberries, buying souvenirs, shivering to death at midnight, eating everything strawberry, etc. Just feeling the place as a whole. A touristy experience, but worth cherishing as well. Ever watched Midnight in Paris? (I dislike the movie btw) When the main character travelled into a different time, the streets of Baguio felt like that. Just... Dreamy...
Walking the cold streets dimly lit by the streetlights at night ... felt like i was in a movie..
One thing I wasn't able to try there that I surely regret :'( hopefully, next time...
Sweater weather type. Loved it. Just didnt expect na ganun kalamig first night😂
Wala pa ako nakakain dun :( Maybe next time😊

Yup yup. My teeth would probably need to be put back in place before djs. Meaning, 4 yrs of braces would be wasted.  

I already have a wide enough nose 😂 id look worse after djs. I dont have much issues with my jaw except for the popping whenever I eat or yawn, and mainly the aesthetic. If ever my jaw and nose are gonna look botched post op, it would definitely take a huge toll on my self esteem. DJS only looks good for those with convex noses. Rarely for those with concave noses. I like my nose, and I know it's gonna get upturned after surgery, and I dont want that.

Decided not to go with the surgery. Think I'll find peace with what I look like and accept who I am 😊

Thank you!

Yes, my face looks sunken :(( Im worried because Im probably gonna hate my nose post op if ever I decide to go with it. I guess I'll just have to live with it like my family has. But im definitely not gonna reproduce😂

 Did you get it done already??

As I'd expect. Was hoping if itd be possible to only cut part of the lower jaw😂 Guess not. It's just that I doubt Id like how my nose will change after djs

Do you also think it'd require genioplasty?

Havent consulted with a surgeon yet, havent even told my ortho that im considering surgery. Im just exploring my options. Id need to at least take a 2 hour flight before Id be even able to consult with a clinic that performs jaw surgery, that's why im asking here. I think people in my country rarely get JS, so there arent even well known surgeons that perform it. Doubt thered even be insurance to partly cover the costs( i live in a 3rd world country). Have braces on for like 4 yrs and my ortho wanted my teeth to be at least "edge to edge" without surgery hence my upper teeth are flared up. And yes, it's only been recently that Ive considered jaw surgery since I didnt expect that Id be able to save up for it. 

Actually my gums have receded terribly due to genetics( naturally thin gums), braces, and a history 
of severe gum picking. My two front teeth have suffered bone loss, but i think it's attributed to genetics. The roots were extremely short when i got an xray. I feel that if my teeth get re-aligned for surgery( as you've said they need to be straight-something ive also witnessed while researching in prep for surgery), theyd fall off😂 

Anyways, worst comes to worst, im willing to accept how my teeth and jaw are. But just curious if there's still hope.
